headline: Paraguayan Senate Debates Impeachment as President Santiago Peña Faces Crisis
summary: The Senate of Paraguay resumed session to analyze the impeachment process of President Santiago Peña, who announced his resignation amid a political crisis triggered by the collapse of digital bank Ueno.
why: Political instability and executive transitions in emerging market sovereign states can introduce severe volatility into local bond markets and currency stability.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political turmoil and potential presidential resignation undermine institutional stability in Paraguay.
